name: GCP — API Access From External / Non-Corporate IP (v2)
alert_name: GCP — API Access From External / Non-Corporate IP (v2)
description: GCP principal making 3+ API calls from a public IP it has not used in the previous 7 days (excluding RFC1918 and Google front-end / IAP ranges): stolen credentials or a new attacker source.
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = google_cloud_logging_raw
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null and xdm.source.user.username != null
| filter not (incidr(xdm.source.ipv4, "10.0.0.0/8")
              or incidr(xdm.source.ipv4, "192.168.0.0/16")
              or incidr(xdm.source.ipv4, "172.16.0.0/12")
              or incidr(xdm.source.ipv4, "35.235.240.0/20")
              or incidr(xdm.source.ipv4, "35.191.0.0/16")
              or incidr(xdm.source.ipv4, "130.211.0.0/22"))
// First appearance of this (principal, IP) pair inside the 7-day window, in the last hour.
// Employees' office and home addresses recur daily, so only a new source survives.
| comp min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen, count() as api_calls
  by xdm.source.ipv4, xdm.source.user.username
| filter api_calls >= 3 and timestamp_diff(current_time(), first_seen, "MINUTE") <= 60
| alter caller_ip = xdm.source.ipv4, principal = xdm.source.user.username
| fields caller_ip, principal, api_calls, first_seen, last_seen
